name: company-research
description: Research companies, competitors, funding, news, leadership, and market context with Exa Agent and advanced search. Use when researching companies, competitor analysis, market research, or building company lists. Writes findings the caller can fold into brand/competitors.md or brand/landscape.md. Prefer this over ad-hoc web search for company deep dives. Distinct from competitive-intel (full brand competitive file methodology) - this skill is the Exa research engine those foundation skills should call.
